patch.value: The docstring gate scanned installed extension artifacts, so it disagreed with itself across machines

analyzeDocstringCoverage walked the package root without skipping .agents, so it descended into .agents/pm/extensions/ where the pm CLI installs extension artifacts. Those files are gitignored installed output, so the same commit could fail release:check on a developer machine that had an extension installed and pass in a clean CI checkout. Added .agents to the structural skip list, alongside node_modules and dist, with a regression test that fails when the entry is removed.
The docstring gate reports the same result for a given commit whether or not extensions are installed locally.
Extension artifacts under .agents are skipped; a regression test covers it and fails when .agents is removed from SKIP_DIRS. 164 tests pass.
Added .agents to SKIP_DIRS as a structural exclusion so installed extension artifacts are never scanned.
